claims.text: Patient reports new dizziness after a lisinopril 20 mg morning dose, with home blood pressure of 98/62 mmHg.

citations.quote: new dizziness after lisinopril 20 mg morning dose. Home blood pressure was 98/62 mmHg.

claims.text: A staff note records that the patient started lisinopril 10 mg seven days ago.

citations.quote: Patient started lisinopril 10 mg seven days ago.

claims.text: The record contains a conflicting dose fact for lisinopril: 10mg versus 20mg.

open_questions: Which lisinopril dose is current: the 10 mg recorded in the staff note or the 20 mg reported in the nurse consult summary?
When was lisinopril first prescribed, and at what starting dose?
When and why was the lisinopril dose increased from 10 mg to 20 mg?
Were there earlier reports of dizziness, low blood pressure, or other adverse effects with lisinopril?
What were the home blood pressure readings before starting lisinopril?
What was the patient's blood pressure and renal function at follow-up after starting lisinopril?
Are other antihypertensives or diuretics also being taken, and were doses adjusted?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded for this patient?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

citation.quote: new dizziness after lisinopril 20 mg morning dose. Home blood pressure was 98/62 mmHg.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Patient-reported dizziness after lisinopril with a home blood pressure of 98/62 mmHg, plus a documented dose conflict (10 mg vs 20 mg).
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to review the reported dizziness and low home blood pressure and clarify the current lisinopril dose.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Deterministic check found conflicting lisinopril dose facts (10mg versus 20mg) in the record.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to reconcile the lisinopril dose in the medication list.
